name: มารยาริษยา ( Mar Ya Ris Ya )
original_name: มารยาริษยา ( Mar Ya Ris Ya )
overview: A story about the fierce rivalry and drama in the fashion industry. Dini, a top supermodel whose career is declining, finds herself threatened by Deeny, a rising star girl-next-door who appears innocent but is actually manipulative and ruthless, willing to do anything to take Dini's place.
